gloss_en: Why does the IFC4 Reference View exclude material layer sets, when layers are fundamental for exchange and contracts?
title_original: Why are material layer sets excluded from IFC4 Reference View MVD?
question_paraphrase: RV is the only final IFC4 MVD so it is what vendors export, but without IfcMaterialLayerSet it is unusable for contract specification. Thoughts?
answer_summary: RV prefers IfcMaterialConstituentSet plus IfcShapeAspects; thickness can be kept via IfcPhysicalComplexQuantity; vendor exports inconsistent (Revit links only with base quantities, ArchiCAD leaves Discrimination empty).

gloss_en: Is there a list of changes between IFC2x3 and IFC4, e.g. renamed entities like IfcBuildingElement to IfcBuiltElement?
title_original: List of changes between IFC versions?
question_paraphrase: Short polite post asking for a changelog of renamed/deprecated entities and subtypes between schema versions, with one example.
answer_summary: Schema specs contain a ChangeLog annex (Annex F); changes only published with official releases; watch buildingSMART GitHub for IFC4.3 work.

gloss_en: Is 'IFC 4.3' (with space) officially a change in naming versus IFC4X3? It affects search results.
title_original: Is "IFC 4.3" officially a change in the naming schema?
question_paraphrase: Admits it may seem trivial but spacing changes forum search results; asks whether the naming convention officially changed.
answer_summary: EXPRESS schema identifier IFC4X3_ADD2 is authoritative; support later confirmed buildingSMART writes versions with a space in prose.

gloss_en: What is the actual official status of IFC4 ADD2 TC1? A friend says a docs site labels it Official but I find no confirmation.
title_original: What is the actual status of IFC4ADD2TC1
question_paraphrase: Non-native English, brief: friend pointed to doc site marked official, no news on buildingSMART site; asks for the real status and where changes are documented.
phrasing_notes: 'L.S.' greeting and sign-off, context then direct question
answer_summary: TC1 is official, baseline for IFC4 RV certification and ISO 16739-1:2018; problem was outdated websites.

gloss_en: How does bSI software certification work? ArchiCAD 24 got many IFC fixes but certification dates from 2019; is v24 certified and why no IFC4 certification docs?
title_original: bSI Software Certification and IFC4
question_paraphrase: Formal, multi-paragraph, quotes certification rules, ends with pointed questions about whom to trust.
answer_summary: Answerers say IFC2x3 certification was lax, IFC4 is pass/fail with no public problem docs; OSArch MicroMVD suggested as transparent alternative.

gloss_en: Is every 2x3 Coordination View implementer agreement implied in IFC4+, or should CVs be updated for newer schemas?
title_original: IFC 2x3 implementation agreements status in IFC4+
question_paraphrase: Direct yes/no question plus second related question, linking implementation agreements page.
answer_summary: Consensus: IFC4 shouldn't need CVs; some agreements (colour/material) still resolve ambiguity; note CV = Coordination View, an IFC2x3 MVD.

gloss_en: How to export a structural model from Revit to ETABS via IFC? ETABS says 'Could not find ENDSEC at end of file'; I exported IFC 2x3 and grids show as not exported.
title_original: Como poder exportar un modelo 3D estructural realizado en Revit a ETABS por medio del formato IFC?
question_paraphrase: Polite formal Spanish thesis researcher; step-by-step description; asks how to change grid export option.
answer_summary: Answerers asked for schema version, encoding, truncation, STEP vs XML; no resolution. Suggested ETABS support.

gloss_en: Are there public, ideally machine-readable mappings for upgrading/downgrading between IFC2X3 and IFC4?
title_original: IFC2X3 to IFC4 mappings
question_paraphrase: Hedged ('I think', 'I guess'), asks for pointers, proposes automated changelogs.
answer_summary: Annex F changelog is parseable but omits renames; use IfcOpenShell schema introspection; polls show migration tools wanted free and local; WIP converter announced.

gloss_en: How do MVD, IDM, COBie and OWL differ and do I have to choose among them?
title_original: Question about MVD, IDM, COBie, etc.
question_paraphrase: Polite brief non-native English, admits confusion about 'these many formats'.
answer_summary: IFC is a schema not a file format; MVD is a subset for an exchange; COBie is an MVD for FM handover on 2x3/IFC4.

gloss_en: Three years after DTV was introduced it has no documentation; has anyone used it for cross-software collaboration?
title_original: IFC4 Design Transfer View experiences?
question_paraphrase: Short open question asking for experiences.
answer_summary: DTV never finalized; Revit DTV is CV2.0 plus advanced BReps, now unofficial; RV 1.2 is most common IFC4 exchange; advanced BRep/CSG fail across tools.

gloss_en: Where are the definitions of the three IFC 4.3 MVDs (Reference View, Alignment-based RV, Design Transfer View)?
title_original: Official Model View Definitions for IFC 4.3
question_paraphrase: Brief, notes gaps: no direct doc link, no 4.3 folder in MVD release repo, DTV for IFC4 also missing.
answer_summary: Two official MVDs exist for 4.3; DTV never became official; abstract entity is in MVD if any child is.

gloss_en: Why are CSG representations mandated for DTV? MVDs are not universally applicable; Blender prefers B-reps.
title_original: Why are CSG representations mandated for DTV?
question_paraphrase: 'At the risk of going off-topic' debate opener about applicability of MVDs.
answer_summary: DTV assumes advanced geometry support; lossless round trip infeasible; suggestion of conservative IFC processing preserving unedited entities.

gloss_en: Revit 2x3 IFC export gives fittings a different colour from the connected system; how is colour tied to geometry in 2x3?
title_original: Need help with Revit 2x3 ifc export, trying to figure out how the colors are assigned.
question_paraphrase: Tentative first-time post, step by step what he tried, screenshot.
answer_summary: Two styling paths: IfcStyledItem on representation items, or via IfcMaterial -> MaterialDefinitionRepresentation; schema oddity.

gloss_en: How to store geolocation in IFC2X3, which lacks IfcMapConversion/IfcProjectedCRS (proposal: use psets on IfcSite)?
title_original: Geolocation standards in IFC2X3 and IFC4
question_paraphrase: Proposal-style post with three numbered proposals and Sydney EPSG example.
answer_summary: Psets (EPset_ProjectedCRS/MapConversion) only needed for 2x3; georef user guide v2 published Feb 2020.

gloss_en: How to merge entities from IFC4 files into IFC4 or IFC2X3 files with IfcOpenShell? I get an error.
title_original: Merging IFC2*3 Elntities in a IFC4 file
question_paraphrase: Short problem statement, entities named IfcTransportElement, IfcDiscreteAccessory.
answer_summary: add() does not work across schemas; hack: change schema identifier to IFC2X3 and fix errors; Geometry Gym can upgrade/downgrade.

gloss_en: Why did some property names change between IFC2x3 and IFC4 (EnvironmenalClass to ExposureClass) with no changelog entry?
title_original: IFC4 property name changes
question_paraphrase: Gives two concrete examples (with typos) and asks for rename document to update automation mapping.
phrasing_notes: typos copied from source; precise examples
answer_summary: Diff the computer-interpretable psets between versions; suggest schema version control.

gloss_en: Where is the IFC4 Design Transfer View spec? The MVD database link is empty.
title_original: IFC4 design transfer view spec
question_paraphrase: Short, notes RV was easy to find but DTV index page empty.
answer_summary: DTV is 'suspended'; first draft too general; focus on RV; micro-MVDs proposed.

gloss_en: IFC4 Reference View export shows no materials for layered walls but Design Transfer does; copying the setting changes much more than expected.
title_original: Materials in IFC difference between IFCVersions
question_paraphrase: Detailed observation, asks whether it's a bSI requirement; complains about hidden options.
answer_summary: RV uses IfcMaterialConstituentSet not layer sets; viewers looking only for layer sets say materials missing; custom setup alters BuildingElementParts/Qto.

gloss_en: What does the Exchange Requirement setting actually do when exporting IFC4?
title_original: INQ: Documentation of Exchange Requirement setting
question_paraphrase: Reads code to find clues, quotes PartExporter, asks for docs.
answer_summary: Intended behaviour per buildingSMART exchange scenarios (e.g. Structural exports parts); closed as expected.

gloss_en: IFC4x3 is official now; when will the exporter support quantity sets (still experimental)?
title_original: INQ: Ifc4x3 official release: exporter supporting Quantity Sets
question_paraphrase: Friendly inquiry, mentions Revit build and what's missing.
answer_summary: Autodesk: working on 2023-2025 updates; 4.3 less stable than 2x3/IFC4 for now; hope it replaces 2x3.

gloss_en: Category mapping UI lets me mix 2x3 and 4.3 classes; bind mapping templates to IFC version.
title_original: ENH: Category mapping ifc version consistency
question_paraphrase: Clear enhancement description with proposed behaviour.
answer_summary: Revit auto-converts IFC4.3 entities to nearest when exporting 2x3; users keep separate configs per version.

gloss_en: Add export option to avoid IfcAdvancedBrep in IFC4 DTV; Solibri and Trimble don't support it; RV lacks layers so projects stay on 2x3.
title_original: Option to prevent export of IfcAdvancedBrep
question_paraphrase: Practitioner voice explaining why projects persist with IFC2x3 CV.
answer_summary: Maintainers asked which tools affected and whether auto fallback would suffice; commenters note Revit uses AdvancedBrep where extrusions suffice.

gloss_en: Revit can't open an IFC containing IfcTriangulatedFaceSet (new in IFC4); do I need to link instead?
title_original: Can't import IfcTriangulatedFaceSet
question_paraphrase: Gives Revit version/add-in, sample from buildingSMART site, asks if supported.
answer_summary: Open IFC only partially supports IFC4; link works for RV; DTV never finalized.

gloss_en: Open IFC vs Link IFC give very different results; Open creates in-place families without IFC data.
title_original: IFC Import - Link Vs Open
question_paraphrase: Asks for official feedback; compares assemblies handling.
answer_summary: Separate code paths; roadmap to unify via Link IFC code base supporting reference and design transfer.

gloss_en: IFC4x3 Reference View export writes ViewDefinition [CoordinationView] in the header instead of ReferenceView.
title_original: PR: IFC4x3 Reference View export writes CoordinationView in FILE_DESCRIPTION
question_paraphrase: Bug report with header excerpt and screenshots.
answer_summary: Reproduced in 2026.4; fixed in 2027; tracked internally.

gloss_en: Hollow square columns with steel connections are displaced in IFC2x3 and corrupt in IFC4 (BIM Vision cannot open).
title_original: BUG: Closed square profiles displaced in IFC2x3 and corrupt in IFC4
question_paraphrase: Reporter asks maintainers to relabel enhancement as bug.
answer_summary: Autodesk confirmed same class for 2x3; tracked, no fix yet.

gloss_en: Material pset for walls with several layers not exported in IFC4 Reference View; is it me or the reader?
title_original: Material pset Wall/Floors with several material layers not exported IFC4
question_paraphrase: Short, unsure whether bug or viewer.
phrasing_notes: 'not sure if I am doing something wrong'
answer_summary: Check if IfcMaterial exists and if viewer supports constituent sets.

gloss_en: Bonsai errors loading my model exported as IFC4 Reference View, but IFC4x3 export loads fine.
title_original: Blender Bonsai Error With Loading in IFC model
question_paraphrase: Auto-generated error report; commenter reports switching schema fixed it.
answer_summary: Suggested upgrading to 0.8.2 and sharing model; workaround exporting IFC4x3.

gloss_en: ifcopenshell.SchemaError: Unsupported schema IFC4X3 when opening an IFC4x3 file.
title_original: ifcopenshell.SchemaError: Unsupported schema: IFC4X3
question_paraphrase: Traceback, docker/conda env.
answer_summary: Schema identifier must be IFC4X3_ADD2; builds differ in compiled schemas.

gloss_en: Error opening an IFC4 DTV file from Revit 2022 in Bonsai.
title_original: Error on opening an IFC4 DTV file coming from Revit 2022
question_paraphrase: Auto error report.
answer_summary: Turned out to be broken Bonsai install (schema module), fixed by reinstall.

gloss_en: BIMserver can't render IFC4 RV from ArchiCAD 23, same project in IFC2X3 displays fine.
title_original: BIMServer does not render IFC4 files from ARCHICAD 23
question_paraphrase: Bug report, exception log.
answer_summary: Root cause IfcPolygonalFaceSet unsupported in geometry engine.

gloss_en: IFC from BlenderBIM does not open in Revit (Open mode), only linking works.
title_original: IFC file doesn't import/open into Revit
question_paraphrase: Thread about Open failing for IFC4.
answer_summary: Revit Open does not support IFC4 tessellations; use Link or Force Faceted Breps workaround.

gloss_en: Bonsai IFC shows fine in Blender but walls/doors lose heights and positions in Revit.

question_paraphrase: Beginner asks if Bonsai needs special export settings for Revit.
answer_summary: Walls with boolean cuts fail in strict importers; viewers disagree; schema not stated.

gloss_en: Check whether an IFC4 export really is Reference View compliant
prompt: client wants IFC4 RV. check this export - is it actually RV or is it the DTV with advanced breps?
expected_behavior: Detect IfcAdvancedBrep/CSG/parametric profiles, material layer sets vs constituents, header view; conclude RV vs DTV-like and list violations.

gloss_en: Compare materials in two exports (RV vs DTV)
prompt: have two exports of same wall, one RV one DTV. why does one have no layers? compare materials
expected_behavior: Compare IfcMaterialLayerSet vs IfcMaterialConstituentSet, quantities, BuildingElementParts across both files and explain.

gloss_en: Count IfcAdvancedBrep elements that Solibri will not understand
prompt: сколько в ифс4 файле элементов с AdvancedBrep? солибри их не видит, нужен список по категориям
expected_behavior: Count IfcAdvancedBrep/IfcAdvancedFace users, group by class and ObjectType, list GUIDs, suggest export without them or IFC2x3.

gloss_en: Which version to choose for contractors
prompt: подрядчик просит ифс, но не говорит какой. 2x3 или 4? какой вьюшкой выгружать
expected_behavior: Explain 2x3 CV2.0 vs IFC4 RV vs 4.3, recommend asking EIR, default to 2x3 CV2.0 for broad compatibility, RV where supported.

gloss_en: Downgrade IFC4 to IFC2x3 and report losses
prompt: 这个IFC4的模型能不能转成IFC2x3？帮我看看会丢哪些东西
expected_behavior: Check schema, entities not in 2x3 (e.g. PolygonalFaceSet, constituent sets), perform/describe conversion and list losses.

gloss_en: Verify file delivered satisfies required IFC2x3
prompt: 甲方要求交付IFC2x3，帮我检查一下这个文件的版本和视图定义对不对
expected_behavior: Read FILE_SCHEMA and ViewDefinition, confirm IFC2X3 and CoordinationView 2.0, list deviations.

gloss_en: Why does ETABS reject this IFC
prompt: el ifc que saque de revit no abre en etabs, dice que falta ENDSEC. que version es y esta truncado?
expected_behavior: Check schema, encoding, EOF/ENDSEC presence, file size sanity, report cause and re-export advice.

gloss_en: List classes differing between two schema versions in my model
prompt: quais entidades do meu modelo ifc4 nao existem no ifc2x3? preciso entregar em 2x3
expected_behavior: List entity classes used in file that are absent or renamed in IFC2x3, counts and mapping suggestion.

gloss_en: Check IFC4 RV vs AIA requirement
prompt: AG fordert IFC4 Reference View. Prüf mal ob die Datei wirklich RV ist und nicht 2x3 oder IFC4x3
expected_behavior: Read schema and view; confirm IFC4 and ReferenceView, verify constituent material sets, note deviations.

gloss_en: Export a copy of this model as IFC2x3 for the subcontractor
prompt: peux tu me sortir une version ifc2x3 de ce modele, le sous-traitant n'ouvre pas l'ifc4
expected_behavior: Convert/export to IFC2X3 CV2.0, warn about lost features, verify result schema.

gloss_en: Show FILE_SCHEMA and which Revit exported it

gloss_en: Which Revit export setting for IFC4
prompt: 레빗에서 IFC4 내보낼때 Reference View랑 Design Transfer View 중에 뭐 써야돼요?
expected_behavior: Explain RV is the certified/common one, DTV unofficial with advanced BReps; recommend RV for coordination.

gloss_en: Why does this IFC4 not open in Revit
prompt: ho esportato in ifc4 da archicad ma revit non lo apre, solo collegato. perche?
expected_behavior: Check schema, tessellated/polygonal face sets, explain Open vs Link limits, suggest IFC2x3 or faceted brep.

expected_behavior: Migrate with schema-aware tooling, list entities with no IFC4 equivalent (IfcAlignment, IfcPavement...), report results.

gloss_en: Is this deliverable compliant with the schema in the EIR
prompt: EIR says IFC2x3 CV2.0. contractor sent this. compliant? just yes/no plus reasons
expected_behavior: Read schema and ViewDefinition, compare with EIR, answer with reasons.

gloss_en: Navisworks shows nothing from IFC4 export
prompt: навис не показывает ифс4 из ревита, 2x3 нормально открывается. че делать
expected_behavior: Explain tessellation/advanced brep support limits in older viewers, recommend 2x3 CV2.0 or RV with updated tools.

gloss_en: IFC4 vs IFC4.3 differences
prompt: IFC4和IFC4.3有啥区别？做道路桥梁该用哪个
expected_behavior: Explain 4.3 adds infrastructure (alignment, roads, bridges) and ISO status, recommend 4.3 for infra.
